geometryRequirements.insulationOuterDiameterRule: Equal outer diameters when insulation construction and wall thickness are equal

screenVisualStandard.appliesTo: every profile with confirmed screen presence
screenVisualStandard.appearance: ONE thin flexible silver-metallic screening layer combining a fine clearly visible CROSSHATCH mesh texture with the delicate continuous surface of foil; closely spaced crossing wire-like lines, not coarse mesh; subtle flexibility, negligible edge thickness; no thick spiral tapes, broad metal strips, raised armor seams or rigid metal cylinder
screenVisualStandard.placement: under outer protection and around the inner cable assembly; when armor is present show screen and armor as TWO distinct concentric structural layers, screen inside armor
screenVisualStandard.technicalDisclaimer: User-approved symbolic visual convention; neither actual screen material nor actual manufacturer construction is asserted. Retain confirmed technical data separately; never recolor the core conductors to match this symbolic screen.
